subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and destructive `/reset` require confirmation across Control UI, TUI, and channel/Gateway command paths, and should there be any config or opt-out?
rationale: Current behavior is established and intentionally preserved by recent fixes, while the requested safety default and config knob would change session-state UX across multiple surfaces.

options.title: Single confirmation contract
options.body: Require one repeat/confirm step for destructive typed commands on the approved surfaces, and avoid a configurable confirmation depth unless maintainers later need an opt-out.

options.title: Control UI only
options.body: Limit confirmation to browser-visible typed commands and leave TUI/channel command behavior immediate for operator workflows.

options.title: Keep current command semantics
options.body: Leave explicit typed commands immediate and close this as a deliberate power-user contract, relying on button/sidebar safeguards for accidental clicks.

recommendation.title: Single confirmation contract
recommendation.body: Require one repeat/confirm step for destructive typed commands on the approved surfaces, and avoid a configurable confirmation depth unless maintainers later need an opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Control UI session-confirmation and New Chat work makes this the closest current owner for deciding whether the remaining typed-command policy should change.
